titles.zh-Hans: 身为VTuber的我因为忘记关台而成了传说
titles.ja: VTuberなんだが配信切り忘れたら伝説になってた
titles.en: VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral After Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream

2.overview: Awayuki hosts a surprise question-answering stream with her artist and fellow VTuber, followed by an even more surprising karaoke stream.

3.overview: Now down one working mic, Awayuki drops in on her genmate Chami for a replacement... and also discovers the side of her that she doesn't show on stream.

4.overview: While riding the high of her newfound ability to afford games, Awayuki foolishly orders the instrument of pain known as the bane of many a VTuber... the infamous fitness game.

5.overview: The time has come at last for Awayuki to witness the debut of Live-On's brand new fourth-generation VTubers! She remains blissfully unaware of what is about to be unleashed upon the virtual world...

6.overview: Awayuki's schedule is packed with collabs left and right, from competing in an animal-themed quiz stream hosted by Eirai to presenting the weekly Live-On News with Shion.

7.overview: Awayuki runs into Kaeru at the Live-On office, learns more about her past, and one thing leads to another... namely a collab with Kaeru and amusement park visit with Chami.

8.overview: After an incident at her local supermarket, Awayuki gets even closer to Mashiro offline.

9.overview: Shion hosts a duo improv competition for her fellow VTubers to test their comedy chops, while Eirai suffers through a horror game stream with Awayuki as her emotional support.

10.overview: All members of Live-On participate in a company-wide collab to play Desert Werewolf, a game where they must survive in the desert while dealing with deadly threats both from the environment and from the traitors among them.

11.overview: Awayuki gets a surprising and exciting call from her manager - and barely has time to process it before she's dragged into another unhinged collab stream as Mashiro and Alice fight for her affection.

12.overview: Asagiri Hareru's long-awaited concert is here, with her and Awayuki's duet as the finale. Through it, Awayuki finally learns about Hareru's past - and the true nature of the connection that brought them together today.
